ValidationRule.description: This is to restrict ability to modify fields that become editable as a default as soon as 'Edit' permission is added to the permission set Created specifically for Claim Manager Permission set under ClaimManagerGroup permission set group
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
OR (
ISCHANGED( Has_Car__c ), ISCHANGED(Preferred_Channel__c), ISCHANGED(FirstName), ISCHANGED(LastName), ISCHANGED(MiddleName)
),
$Permission.Contact_Cannot_Edit_fields, $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You don't have permission to edit this field, please contact your system admin
